# lhasa

- Upstream: https://github.com/fragglet/lhasa
- Version: 0.4.0
- License: ISC (see `COPYING`)
- Used by: `user_prog/AppStore` to read the LHA self-extracting archive inside
  the Quake shareware ZIP. The command-line front-end and the Unix/Windows
  platform files are not included; a small Hashx86 port supplies the platform
  hooks and the input-stream callbacks.
